translations.en.sahih: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
translations.en.yusufali: For the covenants (of security and safeguard enjoyed) by the Quraish,

translations.en.sahih: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
translations.en.pickthall: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.
translations.en.yusufali: Their covenants (covering) journeys by winter and summer,-
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) kebiasaan mereka bepergian pada musim dingin dan musim panas.

translations.en.sahih: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
translations.en.pickthall: So let them worship the Lord of this House,
translations.en.yusufali: Let them adore the Lord of this House,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka hendaklah mereka menyembah Tuhan Pemilik rumah ini (Ka'bah).

arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
transliteration: Allazi at'amahum min ju'inw-wa-aamana hum min khawf

translations.en.sahih: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
translations.en.pickthall: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.
translations.en.yusufali: Who provides them with food against hunger, and with security against fear (of danger).
translations.id.indonesian: Yang telah memberi makanan kepada mereka untuk menghilangkan lapar dan mengamankan mereka dari ketakutan.
